howItWorks.title: Pick a product
howItWorks.body: Browse categories or shop by business need — every item shows starting price and turnaround.

howItWorks.title: Customise & upload
howItWorks.body: Choose size, finish, and quantity. Email or WhatsApp print-ready files, or visit us with a USB.

howItWorks.title: We print & proof
howItWorks.body: Our team reviews artwork, confirms colour and stock, then runs your job on digital or offset.

howItWorks.title: Pickup or delivery
howItWorks.body: Collect at BTM 2nd Stage same day on select items, or coordinate delivery across Bengaluru.

promises.title: Customised your way
promises.body: Choose size, finish, and quantity on every product — upload artwork or brief our design desk for proofs.

promises.title: 100% satisfaction focus
promises.body: We check files before print, match brand colours where needed, and call you if anything needs fixing.

promises.title: Production you can trust
promises.body: Digital & offset capability under one roof at BTM — same quality whether you walk in or order online.

faqs.question: Does Fast Prints offer same-day delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes — selected products like flyers, pamphlets, photo prints, and document prints can be ready for same-day pickup at our BTM Layout store.

faqs.question: Can I order small quantities?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Many products start from single pieces (photo prints, passport photos) or low MOQs (100 visiting cards, 25 ID cards).

faqs.question: How do I send my design files?
faqs.answer: Email print-ready PDFs to fastprintsbtm@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 91647 79922, or walk in with a USB drive at the store.

faqs.question: What are your most popular products?
faqs.answer: Visiting cards, pamphlets, ID cards, lanyards, photo prints, calendars, and wall signage are our top sellers.

facility.title: Professional equipment. Premium output.
facility.body: Walk into BTM or order online — your job runs on the same production line. Digital, offset, large format, and finishing — all under one roof.

machines.name: Digital production press
machines.description: Visiting cards, brochures, flyers, and short-run corporate print with fast turnaround.

machines.name: Offset & multicolour
machines.description: High-volume pamphlets, books, and stationery with consistent colour across thousands of copies.

machines.name: Large format & signage
machines.description: Banners, wall graphics, flex, and indoor signage for retail, events, and office branding.

machines.name: Finishing & ID production
machines.description: Lamination, binding, die-cut, ID card printing, and lanyard assembly under one roof.

brandShowcase.title: Your complete print partner in Bengaluru
brandShowcase.body: From visiting cards to wall murals — Fast Prints handles design, production, and pickup at BTM Layout with same-day options on select jobs.
